items.source: The default implementation is empty. Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认实现为空。可在子类中重写。

items.source: objectName - the actual ObjectName that the MBean was registered with
items.translation: objectName - 该 MBean 注册时使用的实际 ObjectName

items.source: objectName - the suggested ObjectName for the MBean
items.translation: objectName - MBean 建议的 ObjectName

items.source: By setting the registrationPolicy property to RegistrationPolicy.IGNORE_EXISTING the registration process will simply ignore existing MBeans leaving them registered. This is useful in settings where multiple applications want to share a common MBean in a shared MBeanServer.
items.translation: 通过将 `registrationPolicy` 属性设置为 `RegistrationPolicy.IGNORE_EXISTING`，注册过程将简单地忽略已存在的 MBean，使其保持注册状态。这在多个应用程序希望共享公共 MBean 的共享 `MBeanServer` 的设置中非常有用。

items.source: Setting registrationPolicy property to RegistrationPolicy.REPLACE_EXISTING will cause existing MBeans to be replaced during registration if necessary. This is useful in situations where you can't guarantee the state of your MBeanServer.
items.translation: 设置 `registrationPolicy` 属性为 `RegistrationPolicy.REPLACE_EXISTING` 将在必要时在注册期间替换现有的 MBeans。这在您无法保证 `MBeanServer` 的状态的情况下非常有用。

items.source: Sub-classes can receive notifications when an MBean is registered or unregistered by overriding the onRegister(ObjectName) and onUnregister(ObjectName) methods respectively.
items.translation: 子类可以通过分别重写 onRegister(ObjectName) 和 onUnregister(ObjectName) 方法，在 MBean 注册或注销时接收通知。

items.source: All registered MBeans are tracked and can be unregistered by calling the #unregisterBeans() method.
items.translation: 所有已注册的 MBean 均会被跟踪，并且可以通过调用#unregisterBeans()方法进行注销。

items.source: By default, the registration process will fail if attempting to register an MBean using a ObjectName that is already used.
items.translation: 默认情况下，如果尝试使用已使用的ObjectName注册 MBean，注册过程将失败。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to onRegister(ObjectName).
items.translation: 默认实现委托给onRegister(ObjectName)。

items.source: Specify the MBeanServer instance with which all beans should be registered. The MBeanExporter will attempt to locate an existing MBeanServer if none is supplied.
items.translation: 指定所有 Bean 应注册到的 `MBeanServer` 实例。如果未提供，`MBeanExporter` 将尝试查找现有的 `MBeanServer`。

items.source: Return the ObjectNames of all registered beans.
items.translation: 返回所有已注册 bean 的 ObjectNames。

items.source: Called when an MBean is registered under the given ObjectName.
items.translation: 在给定ObjectName下注册 MBean 时调用。

items.source: The policy to use when attempting to register an MBean under an ObjectName that already exists.
items.translation: 尝试在已存在的 ObjectName 下注册 MBean 时使用的策略。

items.source: Actually register the MBean with the server. The behavior when encountering an existing MBean can be configured using setRegistrationPolicy(RegistrationPolicy).
items.translation: 实际上将 MBean 注册到服务器。遇到已存在的 MBean 时的行为可以通过setRegistrationPolicy(RegistrationPolicy)进行配置。

items.translation: 返回将注册这些 bean 的MBeanServer。

items.source: Actually unregister the specified MBean from the server.
items.translation: 实际上从服务器中注销指定的 MBean。

items.source: Unregisters all beans that have been registered by an instance of this class.
items.translation: 取消注册由本类实例注册的所有 Bean。
